---
title: "`r params$title`"
params:
  title: "Clustering diagnostics report"
output:
  pdf_document:
    toc: true
geometry: "top=1in, bottom=1in, left=0.75in, right=0.75in"
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
## Rendered by clusterReport(), which puts these objects in the rendering
## environment: diagnostics, data, scores, fit_rows, sections, ks,
## varimp_size, varimp_seed, var_limits.
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
					  fig.width = 6.5, fig.height = 5)
library(longlineTypology)

fy      <- if (is.null(diagnostics$fit_years)) c(1990, Inf) else diagnostics$fit_years
fit_lab <- if (is.finite(fy[2])) paste(fy[1], "to", fy[2]) else
	paste(fy[1], "to the end of the data")
all_lab <- paste(range(as.integer(format(data$ymd, "%Y"))), collapse = " to ")
```

Scenario: `r diagnostics$scenario`. Clustering variables: `r paste(diagnostics$pca_select, collapse = ", ")`. Principal components used: `r diagnostics$n_components`. Fit years: `r fit_lab`.

```{r pca, results = "asis", eval = "pca" %in% sections}
cat("\n\n# PCA\n\n")
cat("Scaling and PCA fitted on the fit years (", fit_lab, "). Scatter plot: all rows (",
	all_lab, ") projected on that PCA.\n\n", sep = "")
print(knitr::kable(as.data.frame(diagnostics$pca_res$rotation), digits = 3))
pca_plots <- plotPCA(diagnostics$pca_res, scores)
```

```{r pca_plots, eval = "pca" %in% sections}
for (p in pca_plots) print(p)
```

```{r gap_head, results = "asis", eval = "gap" %in% sections}
cat("\n\n# Gap statistic\n\n")
cat("Replicate samples drawn from the fit years (", fit_lab, ").\n\n", sep = "")
```

```{r gap, fig.height = 4, eval = "gap" %in% sections}
plotGapSet(diagnostics$gap_stat)
```

```{r gap_table, eval = "gap" %in% sections}
fd <- diagnostics$freq_df
knitr::kable(fd[order(-fd$freq), ], row.names = FALSE,
			 col.names = c("K", "Replicates selecting K"))
```

```{r per_k, results = "asis", eval = any(c("varimp", "vardist") %in% sections)}
child <- "cluster_report_k.Rmd"   # next to this file (knitr runs in its folder)
for (k in ks) {
	cat(knitr::knit_child(child, envir = environment(), quiet = TRUE), sep = "\n")
}
```
